From 39928984956037cabd304321cb8f342e47421db5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Matthew Brost <matthew.brost@intel.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 16:03:46 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] mm/zone_device: do not touch device folio after calling
 ->folio_free()

The contents of a device folio can immediately change after calling
->folio_free(), as the folio may be reallocated by a driver with a
different order.  Instead of touching the folio again to extract the
pgmap, use the local stack variable when calling percpu_ref_put_many().

Link: https://lore.kernel.org/20260410230346.4009855-1-matthew.brost@intel.com
Fixes: d245f9b4ab80 ("mm/zone_device: support large zone device private folios")
Signed-off-by: Matthew Brost <matthew.brost@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Balbir Singh <balbirs@nvidia.com>
Reviewed-by: Vishal Moola <vishal.moola@gmail.com>
Reviewed-by: Alistair Popple <apopple@nvidia.com>
Cc: David Hildenbrand <david@kernel.org>
Cc: Oscar Salvador <osalvador@suse.de>
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Andrew Morton <akpm@linux-foundation.org>

diff --git a/mm/memremap.c b/mm/memremap.c
index ac7be07e3361..053842d45cb1 100644
--- a/mm/memremap.c
+++ b/mm/memremap.c
@@ -454,7 +454,7 @@ void free_zone_device_folio(struct folio *folio)
 		if (WARN_ON_ONCE(!pgmap->ops || !pgmap->ops->folio_free))
 			break;
 		pgmap->ops->folio_free(folio);
-		percpu_ref_put_many(&folio->pgmap->ref, nr);
+		percpu_ref_put_many(&pgmap->ref, nr);
 		break;
 
 	case MEMORY_DEVICE_GENERIC:
-- 
2.34.1

The patch modifies a single file (`mm/memremap.c`) to fix a potential use-after-free issue when freeing zone device folios. Specifically, in the `free_zone_device_folio` function, after calling the driver's `->folio_free()` callback, the folio's contents may change (e.g., due to immediate reallocation). Previously, the code referenced `folio->pgmap` to obtain the pgmap after the callback, which is unsafe. The fix replaces `folio->pgmap` with the already-saved local variable `pgmap`, ensuring the pgmap pointer is obtained before the folio is modified. This change avoids touching the folio after it has been freed.

**Modifications in each file:**
- `mm/memremap.c`: One line change – in the `free_zone_device_folio` function, inside the `case MEMORY_DEVICE_PRIVATE:` block, replace `&folio->pgmap->ref` with `&pgmap->ref` in the `percpu_ref_put_many` call.

**Relationships:**
- The change is isolated to this single file and addresses a logical ordering issue: the pgmap pointer is saved on the stack before calling the `folio_free` callback, so it remains valid even after the folio's contents become stale. This prevents a potential race condition where accessing `folio->pgmap` post-callback could lead to incorrect reference counting or memory corruption.
